listing.name: SDL Sopwith
listing.summary: Fly SDL Sopwith from an upstream portable package. Portcove can maintain the runtime; upstream owns its settings and high scores.

steps.title: Install or keep your existing copy
steps.instruction: Choose Install for a portable runtime maintained by Portcove. Installation options also let you keep an existing copy or download an upstream package to a folder you own.

steps.title: Complete upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the game package and follow the included instructions. This upstream package does not require a separate commercial game installation.

steps.title: Launch and keep up to date
steps.instruction: Launch explicitly after installation. Portcove updates its managed portable runtime. If you register an existing copy instead, choose its executable and keep its current update workflow.

warnings: This project has not been verified for play through Portcove.

presentation.manual_preparation: No original game data is required. Portcove installs and updates the portable runtime. SDL Sopwith normally stores settings and high scores in its upstream preference folder, outside Portcove backups. Declared in-folder fallback files are preserved. Runtime rollback does not roll back those settings.
